searchText: I think (c) would be the most un-ambiguous answer, and whatever it's the right one it should be clarified in the repo <@!97774605351010304> What do you use to consider an epoch finalized? the finalized_checkpoint event or some other state? I’m unclear how there’s a difference. Surely there’s only one finalised state so whenever it’s updated it should be because of a new head state and cause the store to update. if we index from lighthouse its this: https://github.com/gobitfly/eth2-beaconchain-explorer/blob/master/rpc/lighthouse.go#L650-L651 if we index from prysm its this: https://github.com/gobitfly/eth2-beaconchain-explorer/blob/master/rpc/prysm.go#L812 it matches
